purpose: Research-only staged reconstruction of disclosure timing, first-publication vintage, consolidation basis, presentation unit and period semantics for the exact legacy universe; not a model-ready dataset.

input_universe.legacy_id_rule: verbatim ticker + ':' + financial_period; whitespace is retained in the legacy id and stripped only for the KAP query key

mapping.candidate_key: normalized ticker + statement year + KAP period + exact case-insensitive subject 'Finansal Rapor'
mapping.ambiguous_rule: No proven preferred-basis candidate => AMBIGUOUS; never choose by local-value similarity
mapping.first_publication_rule: Earliest exact-key preferred-basis notification by official timestamp
mapping.correction_rule: Retain every preferred-basis notification in timestamp order; later versions never replace the first-publication value

availability.exact_timestamp_rule: first observed trading-session close strictly after the official publication timestamp
availability.exact_date_only_rule: first observed trading-session close after the official publication date

tfrs29.post_confirmed_rule: official detail page explicitly mentions TFRS 29, TMS 29 or inflation accounting

fields.ebitda_rule: MISSING unless the exact pilot-approved taxonomy code exists; no approximate matching

local_comparison.conditional_fields_rule: Record numeric differences but classify audit result as SEMANTIC_MISMATCH until definitions are proven

execution.batch_rule: canary=first 3; medium=next 10; remaining tickers in deterministic chunks of 15
execution.list_windows: one calendar-year window for each required publication year, deduplicated by ticker-year
execution.resume_rule: completed ticker checkpoint is never fetched again; incomplete ticker reuses validated request caches
